title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Glasgow
Salary: £28,000 pro rata
Contract: Temporary - initially 6 months
Hours: Part-time, 25 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Working Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

Pertemps are currently recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team based in Glasgow on an initial 6-month temporary contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented individual with accounts experience who is looking for a part-time role offering hybrid working.

You will be responsible for a range of bookkeeping and accounting duties, including sales and purchase invoicing, direct debit processing and reconciliations, while supporting the wider finance team to ensure the smooth running of the department.

Key Responsibilities
- Raising sales invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Checking and processing purchase invoices.
- Managing monthly direct debits, including setting up new customers.
- Completing invoicing reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Preparing and completing reports within required deadlines.
- Escalating any issues to the Senior Accounts Assistant or Finance Manager as appropriate.
- Supporting colleagues across the finance team to ensure departmental targets are achieved.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring tasks are completed to a high standard.

Skills required:
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Previous experience using Sage would be advantageous, but is not essential.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong numeracy and time management skills.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- A salary of £28,000 pro rata.
- An initial 6-month temporary contract.
- Part-time hours of 25 per week, Monday to Friday.
- Hybrid working, with 3 days in the Glasgow office and 2 days working from home.
- The opportunity to join a collaborative finance team and develop your accounts experience.

Pertemps acts as both an employment business and an employment agency.

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal - RTA Litigation

Location: Glasgow
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 DOE
Working Pattern: Hybrid (2 days office / 3 days home)

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Paralegal to join a well-established and highly regarded Personal Injury team based in Glasgow.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a caseload of litigated Pursuer Road Traffic Accident (RTA) claims, progressing files efficiently while delivering a high standard of client care throughout the claims process. This role offers the opportunity to work within a supportive team environment while managing your own caseload and contributing to the continued success of the department.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a caseload of approximately 60-80 litigated Pursuer RTA claims.
- Progress claims from medical evidence stage through to settlement.
- Draft court pleadings, motions, and other legal documentation.
- Prepare and submit court productions and supporting documentation.
- Assess and calculate clients' losses and supporting evidence.
- Conduct liability and quantum reviews.
- Negotiate settlements with insurers and third-party representatives.
- Maintain regular communication with clients, ensuring exceptional levels of client care.
- Liaise with medical agencies, counsel, court personnel, insurers and other stakeholders.
- Ensure all files are progressed in line with court deadlines and internal procedures.
- Accurately update the case management system and maintain file records.
- Identify matters requiring escalation to a Solicitor or Team Leader.
- Contribute positively to team objectives and departmental performance.

Skills & Experience Required

Essential
- Previous experience within a Personal Injury litigation environment.
- Experience managing your own caseload.
- Strong understanding of the Scottish litigation process.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- Strong organisational and time management abilities.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Strong client care and relationship management skills.

Desirable
- Experience handling Pursuer RTA litigation files.
- Knowledge of the Compulsory Pre-Action Protocol (CPAP).
- Experience preparing court pleadings and productions.
- Familiarity with Sheriff Court procedures.

Personal Attributes
- Professional and proactive approach.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Resilient and adaptable within a fast-paced environment.
- Committed to delivering exceptional client service.
- Positive and collaborative attitude.

Benefits
- Competitive salary package.
- Hybrid working arrangement.
- Annual loyalty bonus.
- Individual performance bonus scheme.
- Discretionary company bonus.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity for career progression within an established and growing legal practice.

Bonus Scheme

Loyalty Bonus
- £500 annual payment upon completion of the financial year.

Individual Performance Bonus
- 2% of fees generated above £250,000 (pro rata).

Discretionary Bonus
- Additional company performance-related bonus.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

title: Payroll Administrator
